In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the criminal [[Lannik Racto]] owned a hidden '''droid factory''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. There, [[Gender/Legends|he]] mass-produced [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] for sale on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. When Racto was [[Second mission to Coruscant (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|captured]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]], he gave away the location of his factory to [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] authorities, who [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|shut down]] his operations.
